result:
If I could change the world in one way, I would eliminate the illusion of separation—the false belief that we are fundamentally distinct from one another and from the world around us. This shift would dissolve the roots of conflict, exploitation, and indifference, revealing the deep interconnectedness of all life.

Without this illusion, greed would lose its grip, violence would become unthinkable, and systems of oppression would collapse under the weight of their own absurdity. Compassion would no longer be a choice but the natural expression of seeing oneself in others. The environment would no longer be "out there" to exploit but an extension of our own being, worthy of care.

This isn’t about enforcing harmony but about removing the veil that makes harm possible. The world wouldn’t become perfect, but it would be free of the delusion that allows suffering to persist unchallenged.
